title: Darmok: Championship Cryptic Crossword Solving via Constraint Tightening and Resilient Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2611.13557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Darmok, the first automated system to reach superhuman performance on British cryptic crosswords. Unlike American-style crosswords, cryptic clues disguise an unmarked definition and compositional wordplay beneath a misleading surface reading, sparse grids leave nearly half of each word's letters unchecked, and tournament rules rank a grid with even a single wrong or blank square behind all error-free solutions regardless of speed. Competing alongside an elite human field at the 55th Times Crossword Championship in London, Darmok solved all seven championship puzzles error-free and finished faster than every human competitor in every round. It solved the Final puzzle in 6m 52s, a full 3m 13s ahead of the human champion.   Today's frontier AI models can on average solve a whole puzzle in a single try with comparable accuracy and speed. However, cloud API calls still stall, time out, trigger safety refusals, or get stuck in reaso

translated_title: Darmok：通过约束收紧与弹性编排实现冠军级密码填字游戏求解
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Darmok，这是首个在英国密码填字游戏上达到超人表现的自动化系统。与美式填字游戏不同，密码谜题在具有误导性的表面文字之下隐藏着一个未标记的定义以及组合式的文字游戏；稀疏的网格使得每个单词有近一半的字母未被交叉校验；而且锦标赛规则规定，即使只包含一个错误或空白格子的答案，无论速度多快，其排名都会排在所有无错误答案之后。在第55届于伦敦举办的《泰晤士报》填字游戏锦标赛中，Darmok 与人类精英选手同场竞技，无错误地解出了全部七道锦标赛谜题，并在每一轮中的完成速度都快于所有人类参赛者。它以6分52秒解出决赛谜题，比人类冠军快了整整3分13秒。当今的前沿AI模型平均而言可以以相当的准确性和速度在单次尝试中解出整个谜题。然而，云端API调用仍可能停滞、超时、触发安全拒绝，或陷入推理困境（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: Darmok 是首个在英国密码填字游戏上达到超人水平的自动化系统，通过约束收紧与弹性编排技术，在《泰晤士报》填字游戏锦标赛中无错误解出全部七道谜题，且每一轮速度均超过所有人类选手。
en_tdlr: Darmok is the first automated system to achieve superhuman performance on British cryptic crosswords, using constraint tightening and resilient orchestration to solve all seven championship puzzles error-free and faster than every human competitor at the Times Crossword Championship.
